business.what: Tata Power generates, transmits, and distributes electricity from thermal, hydro, and renewable sources, while also providing solar manufacturing, EPC services, and EV charging solutions to diverse customers.

segments.name: Thermal & Hydro
segments.note: Generation from thermal, hydro, coal mining, trading, and shipping.

segments.name: Renewables
segments.note: Wind, solar, rooftop projects, EV charging, and solar manufacturing.

segments.name: Transmission and Distribution
segments.note: Network operations, retail power sales, and power trading.

segments.name: Others
segments.note: Project management, infrastructure services, and satellite communication.

metrics.label: Revenue growth
metrics.reading: Revenue compounded 14% a year over 5 years, 4% over 3 (slowing); last 12 months -4%.

metrics.label: Profit growth
metrics.reading: Profit compounded 27% a year over 5 years, 6% over 3; last 12 months -5%.

metrics.label: Cash conversion
metrics.reading: Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 224% of net profit (strong).

metrics.label: Net debt
metrics.reading: Net debt ₹62,497 cr in FY26, 1.58× equity; up from ₹44,554 cr in FY22.

bull.point: Management successfully beat their net debt-to-EBITDA target of 4x for FY26.
The company beat its FY26 cell and module production target of 3,700 MW.
Operating margin expanded from 16% in FY22 to 21% in FY26.

bear.point: Management missed the FY26 utility scale capacity addition target of 1,600 MW, reaching only 600 MW.
The Mundra plant missed its 80% availability target after being shut for 6 months without capacity charges.
Net debt increased substantially from ₹44,554 cr in FY22 to ₹62,497 cr in FY26.
